text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. For example, instead of saying "improve the website," a SMART goal would be "redesign the homepage within three months." It is also important to define milestones, which are key points during the project that show progress. Deliverables are the final products or results you must complete, such as a report or a new app. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters because everyone involved—team members, managers, and clients—should agree on the goals from the start. This helps avoid confusion and keeps the project on track.
